producer_report.summary: The replay gate no longer exempts a candidate for a phrase. Root cause: INTENDED_REFUSAL_PHRASES let any criterion saying 'higher refusal rate is intended' skip the 10% hold, which is how the rule that newly refused 80% landed on 2026-10-28. The phrase list and criteria_intend_higher_refusal are gone from reading.rs. A candidate now declares a number in a criterion, as 'expected N% of newly refused readings' (whole percent 0-100, first match wins; a percentage not tied to 'newly refused', such as a quoted example, declares nothing). replay_is_held(total, newly, declared: Option<u32>) holds when newly*100 > total*(declared+5), or total*10 with no declaration. A declared share above 25% needs a reason: one criterion or out_of_scope item with 'because', 'now asks' or 'new required' that also names past/previous/earlier/older readings or refuse/refusal words. Without it the share counts as not declared and the 10% limit applies. replay_declaration_of(&Reading) is the single function the gate (replay_run) and the verifier view (replay_view) both use. The stored Replay record is unchanged (intended = declared and not held, because Replay::validate rejects held && intended). ReplayView swaps `intended` for declared, reason and unsupported. The verifier brief prints 'Declared share: N%' and the reason above the replay list, or a note that a share above 25% had no stated reason and 10% applied. CODE_SURVEY_GUIDE teaches the declared form. verify.rs blocker text names the new rule. CHANGELOG.md has a Changed entry under Unreleased. Tests I ran pass: athena-core `reading::` (90) and replay-filtered run tests, all of athena-context, xtask policy, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and one full `cargo test --locked` (no failure reported).

learnings: There is no crates/athena-core/src/brief.rs. The verifier brief code (ReplayView, replay_section, CODE_SURVEY_GUIDE) lives in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, and athena-context cannot import constants from athena-core, so core decides which replay case applies and the brief only prints it.
Replay::validate in athena-data rejects held && intended, so Replay.intended can only mean 'a declared share applied and the job is not held'.
case_id() in reading.rs tests only works for n < 60 (the number is read as seconds in the job id); the 100-case margin test builds its own ids.
The CHANGELOG heading is '## [Unreleased]' with brackets; older entries mention 'refuses more' and 'higher refusal rate is intended' and an existing test reads them, so they stay unedited.
A declared share above 25% needs a reason to apply at all, so a 'declared 30%' test needs a reason or the 10% limit applies.
